# DA11Y.md

> The design edition of A11Y.md. Accessibility rules for designers and AI agents working in design software such as Figma. Same thresholds as A11Y.md, compiled from a pinned copy. WCAG 2.2 AA, portable Markdown, MIT. Current version: 0.1.0 (draft).

## Read this first

- [DA11Y.md, English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/DA11Y.md): the normative core for design. What already exists comes first, the behavior contract on the canvas, what the design must meet, the intent to annotate, delivery and anti-patterns.
- [DA11Y.md, Português (Brasil)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/DA11Y.md): the same core, written in Portuguese.

## Read before designing

- [figma-nodes.md, English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-nodes.md): Figma node types, what each can carry, annotations and measurements, from the official API typings.
- [figma-nodes.md, Português (Brasil)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-nodes.md)

## Component guides

One per A11Y.md guide with something to draw, each translating that guide into Figma nodes, properties, variants and annotations. Load only the one that matches what you are designing.

- [figma-buttons.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-buttons.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-buttons.md): button, CTA, icon-only button
- [figma-forms.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-forms.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-forms.md): form, text field, label, error message, login form
- [figma-form-controls.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-form-controls.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-form-controls.md): checkbox, radio, switch, slider, select, disabled control
- [figma-autocomplete.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-autocomplete.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-autocomplete.md): autocomplete, combobox, searchable select
- [figma-cognitive.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-cognitive.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-cognitive.md): login, sign-up, multi-step flow, time limit, checkout, microcopy
- [figma-modals.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-modals.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-modals.md): modal, dialog, drawer, confirmation
- [figma-consent-banners.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-consent-banners.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-consent-banners.md): cookie or consent banner
- [figma-navigation.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-navigation.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-navigation.md): menu, header, navigation, page headings
- [figma-tabs-accordion.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-tabs-accordion.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-tabs-accordion.md): tabs, accordion, collapsible panel
- [figma-tooltips-popovers.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-tooltips-popovers.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-tooltips-popovers.md): tooltip, popover
- [figma-toasts-notifications.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-toasts-notifications.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-toasts-notifications.md): toast, snackbar, alert
- [figma-loading-skeleton.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-loading-skeleton.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-loading-skeleton.md): skeleton, loading, entry animation
- [figma-carousels-sliders.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-carousels-sliders.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-carousels-sliders.md): carousel, rotating banner
- [figma-drag-drop.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-drag-drop.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-drag-drop.md): drag and drop, reordering, kanban
- [figma-infinite-scroll.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-infinite-scroll.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-infinite-scroll.md): feed, infinite scroll, "load more"
- [figma-images.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-images.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-images.md): image, icon, illustration, avatar
- [figma-media.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-media.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-media.md): video, audio, background video, parallax
- [figma-charts.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-charts.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-charts.md): chart, dashboard, KPI
- [figma-tables.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-tables.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-tables.md): table, data grid
- [figma-datepicker.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-datepicker.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-datepicker.md): date field, calendar
- [figma-treeview.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-treeview.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-treeview.md): tree view, file explorer, nested hierarchy picker
- [figma-maps.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-maps.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-maps.md): map, store locator
- [figma-generative-ui.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-generative-ui.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-generative-ui.md): chat, assistant, generated response
- [figma-visual-perception.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-visual-perception.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-visual-perception.md): color, palette, tokens, theme
- [figma-responsive-mobile.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-responsive-mobile.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-responsive-mobile.md): breakpoint, zoom, responsive layout, touch target
- [figma-platform-native.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/references/figma-platform-native.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/references/figma-platform-native.md): iOS or Android app screen, or an app for a Brazilian audience

## Templates

- [REPORT.md, English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/en/templates/REPORT.md) · [pt-BR](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/docs/pt-BR/templates/REPORT.md): the design accessibility report, delivered with the design and read by the coding agent as prior decisions.

## Tools

- [tools/measure.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/main/tools/measure.js): runs where Plugin API code runs; reads the selection and returns contrast pairs on resolved token values, targets, spacing and text growth as data, ratios truncated. Read-only.

- [tools/compile.py](https://github.com/fecarrico/DA11Y.md/blob/main/tools/compile.py): compiles the blocks shared with A11Y.md and checks numbers, guides and language parity. Python 3.9+, standard library only.
